facts.text: I will just have the salad, thanks. And maybe nobody mention the bill until I have finished.
facts.why: Bruce never says this. His real food line, in poor Portuguese, is 'Don't make me... hungry. You wouldn't like me when I'm... hungry.' It also fits the signed-note idea better.
facts.fix: Don't make me... hungry. You wouldn't like me when I'm... hungry.
